decisions.reason: A semi-hard cheese wheel is a core, versatile assortment item that typically stays in a dairy's range, and it was still on its own page in 2019 while sibling products were dropped.
The spicy cheese was still presented on its own page in 2019, but it is a niche flavour variant and is more exposed to range trimming than staple items.
